data.name: Chihuahua Racing
data.detailed_description:
Chihuahua Racing is the biggest sporting event on planet Chihuahua. Only the top 20 athletes from around the world can participate in the intense and electrifying races.

Be the fastest racer and strategically use the weapons at your disposal to defeat your opponents. Race against opponents on winding tracks full of ramps and obstacles. Make good use of defense and attack, use drifting to take difficult turns, and if needed, use nitro without fear. Each track hides a special power that can be used by the chihuahuas who manage to obtain it.

All this accompanied by an original and intense soundtrack.

Chihuahua Racing is a racing and combat game made by fans of the genre; our goal is to create a fast and intense game that lives up to the name "racing," but also has intense and strategic combat. The feeling of controlling the chihuahuas is the same as controlling a car; the controls are standard for arcade racing games.

You have attack and defense options, as well as mechanics like nitro and drifting. Use bombs, missiles, boosts, ramps, and different special powers on each track to dominate the championship. Face a large number of opponents on varied tracks that demand different strategies, avoid obstacles, perform grand jumps, and be the fastest chihuahua in the world.

The game offers a pure racing experience, without unfairly forcing opponents forward or backward (no "rubber banding"). You can choose different difficulty levels, and if you're fast, you'll be fairly rewarded. Don't be afraid of being attacked by a blue shell on the final lap and losing a race you dominated; Chihuahua Racing is much more about strategy and speed than luck.

Connect two controllers and call a friend to play split-screen mode. Face the other racers together, but in the end, only one can be the winner.

data.short_description: Chihuahua Racing is the biggest sporting event on the planet, where the 20 best athletes in the world race and compete. Be the fastest and use the weapons at your disposal to win. Race on winding tracks full of ramps and obstacles. Make good use of defense and attack, use drifting and nitro to win.
